title: Decision Briefing
summary: Argues a recommendation from research — the evidence, the options weighed, and what the team should do next.

page_types.purpose: Give a reader (live or async) a one-screen kickoff: what this artifact is, who should read which page, and how to ask questions.
State the recommendation as a short numbered list of verdicts, most important first.
List every need or requirement the recommendation must satisfy, so a reader can check the argument against them.
Compare every option considered, cell by cell, against the same criteria.
When refining an existing plan, show what stays the same and justify each individual change in detail.
Show what breaks under each option, so the cost of being wrong is visible up front.
Lay out the plan or rollout as a sequence of phases or dates.
Back the recommendation with real case-study data, generated from the source material.
List what's still unresolved, each with an explicit confidence level.
Auto-built from contents.json's sources[] and every <x-cite> used in the artifact. Not hand-authored.
